Conclusion: The test `test_canonicalize_urlparsed` checks whether the `canonicalize_url()` function correctly handles URLs that have been already parsed using `urlparse`. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case for the URL `'http://www.example.com/caf%e9-con-leche.htm'`. Following the execution path, we find that the failing assertion is caused by a mismatch in the expected and actual output of `canonicalize_url()` function. The expected output is `'http://www.example.com/caf%E9-con-leche.htm'` while the actual output is `'http://www.example.com/caf%EF%BF%BD-con-leche.htm'`. This discrepancy suggests that there might be an issue with how `canonicalize_url()` handles non-ASCII characters or encoded URLs.

scrapy.utils.url.canonicalize_url
